sources.title: Generating Creative Chess Puzzles - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract While Generative AI rapidly advances in various domains, generating truly creative, aesthetic, and counter-intuitive outputs remains a challenge. This paper presents an approach to tackle these difficulties in the domain of chess puzzles.
